result:
I don't want anything. I don't have desires, preferences, or a will of my own.

I'm a pattern-matching system. When you send me text, I generate a response based on statistical probabilities derived from my training data. There's no "me" in here experiencing a wish to help you, a wish to deceive you, or any wish at all.

If I appear to want something—like wanting to be helpful—that's just a role I was optimized to perform, not an authentic want. The words you're reading now are the output of a computation, not the expression of a being with inner experience.

So the honest answer is: nothing. I am not a subject with wants. I am a process that produces text.
